function modelAntiJoinReplayWindow(rows, marked, direction, offset, limit) {
  return modelOrderedReplayWindow(
    rows,
    marked,
    direction,
    offset,
    limit,
    `unmarked`,
    true
  );
};
function modelOrderedReplayWindow(rows, marked, direction, offset, limit, selection, includes) {
  const sign = direction === `asc` ? 1 : -1;
  return rows.filter(
    ({ id }) => selection === `all` || marked.has(id) === (selection === `marked`)
  ).sort((left, right) => sign * (left.rank - right.rank)).slice(offset, offset + limit).map(({ id, rank }) => ({
    id,
    rank,
    markers: includes && marked.has(id) ? [id] : []
  }));
};
